meta.title: Laura Carelli — Staff Software Engineer · Tech Lead · Consultant | snack-factory
meta.description: Laura Carelli — Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead & Consultant. AI-augmented. Backend, mobile and automation, from planning to production. Independent, remote, USD.

hero.tagline: I design, plan and build production software — from the data schema to delivery. Backend, mobile and automation, with the methodology of a serious team.

services.heading: What I do
services.sub: Four ways to bring me in. Pick by how much ownership you want me to take.

backend.title: Custom backend & APIs
backend.desc: REST/reactive APIs, business logic and integrations. Kotlin/Spring WebFlux, PHP, Go. Auth (JWT), payments (Mercado Pago), webhooks, versioned migrations.

mobile.title: Flutter mobile apps
mobile.desc: Cross-platform apps from scratch or joining an existing codebase. Published on the App Store and Google Play — not demos, real products in users' hands.

automation.title: Automation & integrations
automation.desc: Connect systems and remove manual work. n8n, webhooks, scheduled jobs, payment flows, observability. The plumbing that frees a team from doing things by hand.

rescue.title: Project rescue
rescue.desc: Inherited code nobody understands? I audit it, document it, add tests and stabilize it — so it stops being a black box and a risk. Includes implementation planning.

how.heading: How I work
how.sub: Professional where it counts — code, method, delivery. No empty formalities.

plan.title: Plan before code
plan.desc: I show you the files I'll touch and why, and wait for your OK. No surprises, no scope creep.

tests.title: Tests & quality gates
tests.desc: Unit tests on new code, minimum coverage targets, static analysis (SonarQube). I don't hand over code with blocking issues.

docs.title: Documentation that survives me
docs.desc: Clear READMEs, documented endpoints, data models and flows. Your team can keep going without me.

deliveries.title: Agreed deliveries
deliveries.desc: We agree scope, dates and how we communicate up front. You always know where things stand.

ai.title: AI-augmented, not AI-replaced
ai.desc: I work with AI as part of my real workflow — it multiplies my speed and coverage, while engineering judgment, review and accountability stay mine. You get more done per hour, without lowering the bar.

rates.heading: Rates
rates.sub: Hourly, in USD. The rate scales with responsibility: the more I own, the higher within the range.

dev.title: Development
dev.desc: You bring a defined spec or design. I implement it well — clean, tested, documented.

eng.title: Engineering + design
eng.desc: I make the technical decisions for a feature — architecture, data model, trade-offs — and build it.

lead.title: Lead + implementation
lead.desc: I plan the implementation, own the architecture and project organization, and deliver it end to end.

rates.note: Available by the hour, in monthly blocks (e.g. 20/40 h) or per deliverable. Minimum engagement and block discounts on request.

ashvattha.title: Ashvattha Yoga
ashvattha.desc: Yoga studio app published on iOS and Android. Independent product built end to end: reactive Kotlin/Spring backend, Flutter app, payments, waitlists, accounting. From idea to the stores.

planning.title: Project planning & organization
planning.desc: A full project broken down into planned, organized tasks — the planning layer behind the build. Evidence that I don't just code: I structure the work before it starts.

contact.heading: Let's talk
contact.sub: Tell me what you're building. First call is on me — we figure out if I'm a fit.
